program: Volunteer wilderness search and rescue readiness

nutshell.headline: Real rescue capability; highly uncertain marginal health
nutshell.body: A $5,000 whole gift yields 0.01133 expected Bay QALYs in a subjective signed model, or $4,413,582 per10. This is not measured impact; current finances and a marginal readiness offer are unverified.
nutshell.whyItMayWork: Volunteer technical skills and equipment can make a time-critical rescue safer or earlier. The dated operational denominator is16missions in2024.
nutshell.whyWeAreCautious: Most rescue outcomes have multiple producers and alternative teams. Rescued people need not be Bay residents. A favorable5% world provides98.37% of signed expected Bay benefit.
nutshell.recommendationBlocker: HOLD giving on health cost-effectiveness. Need current whole cash accounts and a dated funding-caused capability gap; do not equate rescue contacts with deaths prevented.

summary.detail: Signed expectation before division; all six worlds retained.

summary.detail: Volunteer time, personal equipment, sheriff, aircraft, EMS and hospital resources are not fully priced.

programSection.body: BAMRU is an independent501(c)(3), EIN23-7098709, activated by San Mateo Sheriff and deployed across California. Whole gifts support training, equipment, readiness and deployment, not only successful rescue encounters.

steps.title: Maintain usable capability
steps.detail: Small gifts may improve or preserve trained-person/equipment readiness; cash additionality includes replacement of member giving or public equipment.

steps.title: Change access relative to alternatives
steps.detail: Only a modeled fraction of missions involve responsive live patients and a useful change compared with other teams, helicopters, self-rescue or bystanders.

steps.title: Finite net health
steps.detail: Absolute survival increment times2–10finiteyears at.8utility plus brief distinct survivor morbidity, less independent harms.

programSection.boundary: All ordinary-gift cash is charged. Training, unsuccessful search, recovery, community activity and administration are not removed from expenses. No animal, bereavement or justice benefits credited.

model.headline: Whole-gift readiness-equivalent model
model.body: Current annual cash expenses are analyst assumptions $40k–$100k, not a verified updated2017 filing.16missions is a dated activity anchor, not an annual forecast guarantee. A fractional readiness-equivalent mission is accounting attribution across existing missions, not a newly created emergency. All causal and geographic coefficients are judgments locked before execution.

equation.label: Net Bay health
equation.expression: gift / whole cash expense ×16 ×volume ×cash additionality ×[responsive persons ×earlier safe access ×(absolute mortality improvement ×finite survival years ×utility + separate survivor morbidity utility ×years) −harm] ×Bay share

inputs.label: Whole annual cash expense
inputs.basis: 2017 IRS extraction$32,052 is old and original return not recovered. No inflation/revenue cap presented as current truth.

inputs.label: Dated mission anchor
inputs.basis: Sheriff March2025release. Mission count is not patient count.

inputs.label: Cash-caused readiness
inputs.basis: Members and donors fund cash; Sheriff also replaces equipment. No quoted tranche.

inputs.label: Responsive live persons and differential access
inputs.basis: Partner examples show co-production and sometimes low acuity; no representative patient register.

inputs.label: Survival and morbidity
inputs.basis: Analyst finite packages, not effects estimated by SAR observational literature. Morbidity is on a disjoint survivor pathway, excluding the survival gain.

inputs.label: Bay-resident share
inputs.basis: Statewide missions; Bay residence unmeasured. SF.02–.10 nested subset, not additive.

model.uncertaintyBoundary: 5% subjective mass below$1m/10 and0%below$100k/10, from this discrete scenario set only; not a calibrated probability or claim that unmodeled possibilities are impossible. Favorable tail98.37%; without it price~$257.57m/10.
model.fundingBoundary: No priced marginal gift offer. Historical assets are not current liquidity. The model does not claim a donation creates demand or that volunteer/public complements scale freely. Current full cash expense and complete societal cost remain unknown.

evidence.transfer: Credible output anchor, not efficacy, patient uniqueness or Bay-residence measurement.

evidence.result: BAMRU collaborated with other teams and helicopters; some people were in good condition, others dehydrated/nonambulatory.
evidence.transfer: Mechanism and alternatives, not a representative denominator or a deaths-averted study.

evidence.result: Time/acuity matter; no causal extra-team or donation effect established.
evidence.transfer: No published survival coefficient copied. All absolute-risk improvements and finite utilities remain judgments.

reservations: Current whole-organization accounts not verified; scenario costs are not observed unit prices.
98.37% favorable-tail dependence and largely judgmental clinical bridge.
Whole gift may replace member contributions, reimbursements or already-funded equipment without changing readiness.
Statewide incident locations and Bay victim residence are different; neither is comprehensively measured.
Responder injury, patient handling, delayed alternatives and unsafe deployment are independent harm pathways.
excludedBenefits: Body recovery, family closure, animal rescue and non-health civic value remain unquantified.
No additional caregiver or lifetime disability benefit; no survival after10years.
No fiscal savings or donated equipment retail value converted into QALYs.
